purpose: Consolidate exact-hash-pinned C11-D policy proposals and unresolved decisions without approving policies, admitting candidate input, enabling the renderer, or changing C11-C.

decisions.candidate_summary: Review the pinned proposal's 11 candidate half-open window rules for 14 editorial field instances. The prior proposal runner evaluated zero windows.
Decide whether and how every declared editorial field is consumed by the visual presentation layer. The prior review reported zero of 14 fields visually consumed.
Review the proposed metadata-only language behavior. This docket does not authorize rendering language as visible text.
Review shared presentation-region proposals, including shared header/footer behavior and the Challenge overlay. Coordinate projection and region geometry remain unresolved.
Review the proposed Loop and Drill identity timebase behavior for the fixed 30 FPS fixtures. This does not certify arbitrary inputs.
Review the proposed Challenge source-to-delivery timebase and no-interpolation behavior. winning_frame remains the sole timing truth; close_calls is only a count.
Resolve the declared 11-second duration versus 12-second phase-sum conflict for CHALLENGE_008 and CHALLENGE_009 through an explicit shared temporal authority. No value is selected here.
Keep coordinate projection, visual sampling, region geometry and visibility-window consumption unresolved until explicit source-field policies exist.
Review audio, mux, delivery QA and other unimplemented requirements. Their inclusion in this docket does not imply that implementations exist.
Track arbitrary candidate-input materialization, candidate admission, renderer baseline approval/freeze and separately authorized gates. This docket grants none of them.

non_goals: No policy is accepted or approved by this artifact.
No source-to-region, coordinate, visibility, sampling, audio or timebase mapping is silently adopted.
The CHALLENGE_008/009 11-second versus 12-second conflict is not resolved here.
No renderer is implemented or enabled, and no media is created.
The frozen C11-C baseline and manifest remain immutable.
